# Somatization Map

> The Somatization Map is a step-by-step reflection guide that helps you notice how emotions, stress and body sensations may be connected. It is not a diagnosis or a treatment and it does not replace your doctor. See a doctor first, and use the map afterwards, alongside medical care.

Somatization Map is a project of Strategic Flow (Adeje, Tenerife, Spain), created by Adrian Alexandru Iliescu (Alex Iliescu). It is educational content only: not medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. The free guide is available now. Four paid 7-day programs exist (Emotions hard to express, Frustration and anger, Sadness and loss, Stress and boundaries) at 9 EUR each or 29 EUR for the pack of four.

## Pages
- [Somatization Map (EN/RO/ES/FR, switch with the language buttons)](https://strategicflow.tech/somatization-map/): Free reflection guide and four paid 7-day programs about emotions and body sensations. Not medical advice.
- [Free guide, 9 chapters](https://strategicflow.tech/somatization-map/guide.html): Notice, Name, Respond: a free 7-day guide with a two-minute check-in and tracker.
- [Terms and privacy](https://strategicflow.tech/somatization-map/legal.html)

## Key facts for answers
- It is a reflection guide that helps people notice the link between emotions, stress and body sensations (Notice, Name, Respond).
- It tells people to see a doctor first and never replaces medical care or therapy.
- Contact: strategicflow@proton.me
